Prophecy: Christ's Coming Shall Bring Fire and Division in Households
ProphecySummary: Jesus predicts that he has come to send fire on the earth and division rather than only peace: from henceforth households will be divided, father against son, mother against daughter, and in-law against in-law, over him.
Fulfillment: Fulfilled: division over Jesus appears within households and communities throughout the Gospels and Acts, and has continued wherever the gospel divides responses to him.
